what: From integrate-docs: v2 cannot get its toolchain. Nothing calls crates/blaze-cargo/src/toolchain/own.rs `fetch`, and v2 has no `blaze toolchain` command, so on a machine without rustup nightly-2026-10-27 or ~/.blaze a build stops at toolchain::found ("blaze toolchain is not installed"). install.sh:305 runs `blaze toolchain`, and BLAZE_NO_TOOLCHAIN / --no-toolchain promise the first build downloads it; neither happens. Also: v2 never refuses a member whose rust-version is newer than blaze Rust, and --ignore-rust-version is parsed and unused (blaze-units). docs/toolchain.md and docs/install.md now say both as v2 gaps; fix them there when this lands.
